reopened_reason: Audit interactions among domain completion, induced kernel equality and surviving scalar characters.

new_assertions.body: A common carrier needs two separate contracts: a source-symbol domain for equality closure and a dependency space for linear descent. Equality of finite induced kernels does not erase this distinction, as RS090–091 demonstrate.

The owner obstruction singles out one scalar character in the fixed gauge, but does not canonically choose that gauge or produce a native character formula. A separate scalar-character search is justified; a board draw classifier is not established.

A realizability restriction can legitimately block synthetic equality paths only when derived structurally. Excluding paths because their scalar replay fails would be an outcome-picked exception and would not qualify a closed law.
